paired_glitter_analysis.method: Fit exact fixed-point motion against received pixel coordinates and sequence deltas. Enumerate 64 possible fixed initial horizontal velocity records for Radial. Classify only distinct, in-bounds head/trail coordinates disjoint from all other sparks; intersect classifications across every valid motion/velocity fit.
paired_glitter_analysis.limitations: Offline interpretation of the supplied board capture, not another board measurement. Overlapping or coincident points are excluded; visibility states are inferred from kinematics, while simulation independently proves the gate implementation. The Radial fit permits every combination of its six per-spoke velocity increments rather than assuming unknown launch LFSR state.

exploratory_run_note: An earlier exploratory capture was not marked passed because one USB line was discarded without recording its phase. This recorded rerun instruments attachment and acceptance separately: zero discarded lines in either phase. Board error counters stayed zero in both runs.
